c080.title: An accident in the street
c080.story: On Monday, Anna sees a man fall off his bike. She calls for help, and the [[dispatcher]] sends an ambulance. Soon a [[paramedic]] named Olha arrives. The man is in [[shock]] and has head [[trauma]]. Olha gives him [[morphine]] for the pain. At the hospital, a doctor's [[pager]] beeps, and she runs to him. The man is in a [[coma]] for one day. He needs blood from a [[donor]]. His wife is in great [[distress]], so Anna stays with her. Later, Anna's cousin Ira, an army [[medic]], brings them hot tea. The next evening, the man wakes up and smiles at them.

c082.title: Uncle Petro's way back
c082.story: Anna's uncle Petro is an [[alcoholic]], and the family has worried about him for years. Last spring, after a long fight with [[alcoholism]], he finally went to [[rehab]]. He also stopped smoking, because he did not want [[nicotine]] to control him too. In his support group, one woman used [[heroin]] and other [[opiates|opiate]] for ten years. The group leader explains that these drugs all come from [[opium]], which is made from poppies. A young man talks about [[cocaine]] and [[meth]] and the friends he lost. Another man started with [[marijuana]] at parties and later tried [[LSD]]. He says [[cannabis]] is the plant's proper name, but his friends just called it [[ganja]]. A woman explains how [[amphetamine]] pills ruined her sleep and her job. An older man takes [[methadone]] every day to stay away from street drugs. Petro listens to everyone and feels less alone. On Sunday, he drinks only tea at family dinner, and Anna hugs him.

c083.title: The big match on TV
c083.story: Max is a [[fan]] of the Kyiv Reds. But his dad is a real [[football]] [[fanatic]]. Tonight, they watch the city [[derby]] on TV together. The [[match]] is Kyiv Reds [[versus]] Kyiv Blues. In the first half, the [[referee]] calls a [[foul]] on the Reds. Later, he calls an [[offside]], and Dad shouts at the TV. In the second half, the Reds' [[goalkeeper]] saves a penalty. It is 1-1, so the game goes into [[extra time]]. In the last minute, a [[midfielder]] passes to the fast [[winger]]. He scores the winning [[goal]]! Max and his dad jump up and watch the [[replay]] five times.

c084.title: Max at the gym
c084.story: Max wants to do more [[sport]] this year. He joins a [[club]] with a big [[fitness center]]. His [[trainer]], Oleh, is a [[guru]] with many online followers. Oleh makes a plan to improve Max's [[fitness]]. Max does twenty minutes of [[cardio]] and some [[stretching]]. On Fridays, he goes to a [[pilates]] class with a kind [[instructor]]. One day, an older man shows Max his huge [[biceps]] and [[six-pack]]. "I take special pills for big muscles," he says. "No, thanks, I want to stay healthy," Max answers. Oleh hears this and becomes a real [[mentor]] to Max. After the workout, Max books a long massage.

c085.title: The Kyiv marathon
c085.story: Anna loves [[jogging]] in the park every morning. She checks her speed on her new fitness [[tracker]]. In May, she runs her first race in Kyiv. At the [[start]], she feels nervous but happy. Fast [[runners|runner]] go past her in a quick [[sprint]]. Max says some of them do [[cross-country]] and [[triathlon]] too. Anna runs slowly, but she does not stop. At the end, a young woman from Lviv wins the race. This strong [[athlete]] stands on the [[podium]]. She gets a gold [[medal]] and a big [[prize]]. Journalists ask another [[medalist]] about [[doping]] and [[steroids|steroid]]. Anna has no medal, but she is very proud.
